title: Pricing for customers with and without a discount plan
task: In package `pricing`, customers may have a discount plan (a percentage off, some plans with a minimum order in cents below which the discount does not apply) or no plan at all. `Price(customer Customer, orderCents int64) int64` returns what they pay. A customer with no plan pays full price, and I do not want the pricing code checking for the absence of a plan. Test a plan, a plan below its minimum, and a customer without a plan.
